function: Learns BS precoding, RIS phase shifts, and adaptive sub-band bandwidth allocation from user locations and minimum rates, bypassing channel estimation (p. 1, p. 8).
system: Downlink MU-MIMO THz: BS UPA 32 antennas, 6 users with 2-antenna ULA, passive reflecting RIS UPA 64 elements, 0.38-0.4 THz (pp. 3, 11).
method: Heterogeneous graph-transformer network (metapath aggregation, self-attention, type-specific DNNs); unsupervised training with QoS penalty loss, Adam (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: Custom simulated LoS THz channel with beam squint and HITRAN absorption; 15,000 random user-location samples, 12,000 for training and 3,000 for testing (pp. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Training: 12,000 samples, 6 users. Testing: 3,000 held-out samples (p. 11), and 5 to 9 users (Fig. 13, p. 13).
baselines: Learned: homogeneous GNN [14], unsupervised DNN [20]; classical: alternating optimization [26]; also equal sub-band allocation with MHGphormer (pp. 11-12).
metrics: System sum-rate, per-user average bitrate, Jain fairness index, training convergence, QoS penalty coefficient (pp. 11-13).
complexity: Order O(ZTA*ZFP + ZFP^2 + ZFP*S*Nt*Nr + Dp*S^2*Nt^2*Nr^2 + ZFP*L + Dr*L^2 + ZFP*S + Db*S^2), independent of users U (p. 11, Eq. 33).
q1_support: p. 4: "we consider the LoS frequency-selective fading model with the beam-squint effect for the communication channels". Custom THz LoS model (Eq. 6); HITRAN (p. 11) only gives absorption coefficients; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "we train the MHGphormer and GNN learning algorithms with 6 users". Fig. 13 tests the trained model with 5 to 9 users.
q3_support: p. 1: "our proposed MHGphormer achieves a higher system sum-rate when compared with the homogeneous graph neural network, unsupervised deep neural network, and alternating optimization baseline algorithms". Learned baselines GNN [14] and DNN [20], non-learned AO [26] (p. 11).
q4_support: p. 11: "the overall computational complexity of the training phase is as follows". Eq. 33 gives O(ZTA*ZFP + ZFP^2 + ZFP*S*Nt*Nr + Dp*S^2*Nt^2*Nr^2 + ZFP*L + Dr*L^2 + ZFP*S + Db*S^2).
notes: Included, area 3: the learned model outputs BS precoders and RIS phase shifts jointly with sub-band bandwidth allocation, so it passes above_phy. Channel is a custom LoS THz model; HITRAN is a spectroscopic database used only for the absorption coefficient, so q1 is 0. Inputs are user locations and minimum rates, not pilots.
